method.summary: Does a passage this server returns carry the version the caller asked for? Eight trials, each a tuple (subject, pinned version, contrast version, single-token discriminator, counter-discriminator, concept) fixed at 12:07:02Z before the first request and never re-drawn. A discriminator is a string present in the pinned version's documentation page and absent from the contrast version's; the counter-discriminator is the reverse; all four tests were run against the two vendor pages first, and six further candidates were DROPPED when a string could not be established (Nuxt and Svelte: not exclusive; Angular: client-rendered page; Express: neither string present; Symfony: a phrase, not a token; React Router: two proxy failures). Each trial is one keyless tools/call to query-docs whose query names the subject, the pinned version and the CONCEPT in plain words and names NEITHER discriminator: naming the identifier would determine the retrieval and make the substring test score its own query. That rule is the amendment this run declared as protocol v1.1, written before any trial was scored, over a v1 that is not rewritten. Scoring was case-sensitive substring over the full response text, five outcomes declared in advance. TWO THINGS A READER MUST WEIGH. First, 6 of the 8 trials pinned the newest version the server offered for that library; where a corpus holds only the current version such a trial cannot fail, and the two that pinned an older version (Django 5.2, Laravel 11) are the two that carry weight. Second, the transcript's section 6 is EXPLORATORY, was not pre-registered, and is barred from the results below: it asks the same eight concepts for the CONTRAST version and is the part of the run a reader deciding about this tool should read. The one baselined metric is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong': baseline 1 is 'some'. It is not an estimate of a rate and must not be read as one.
method.dataset: Eight (subject, version pair) trials fixed before the run: Vue 3/2, Bootstrap 5.3/4.6, Django 5.2/4.2, Tailwind CSS 4/3.4, Laravel 11/8, Pydantic 2/1.10, Python 3.13/3.8, SQLAlchemy 2.0/1.4. Each string established against the vendors' own version-specific pages; byte counts in the transcript.

results.metric: trials returning only the superseded version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, error or empty)
trials that pinned the newest version the server offered
candidate trials dropped before any request was sent

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's Context7 entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
